title: Viva Insights: Agent 365 Dashboard view in the Copilot Analytics Agent Dashboard
summary: The briefing passes: the documented licensing, default state, access controls and privacy threshold agree with Microsoft's text. It correctly distinguishes the roadmap's In development status and July target from the preview documentation, and reports the differing administrator-role guidance.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans access to Agent 365 data through the Agent Dashboard in Copilot Analytics, including historical activity across registered agents.
claims.quote: Customers can now access their Agent 365 data through the Agent Dashboard in Copilot Analytics (Insights), enabling leaders to understand activity across all agents registered through Agent 365.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard page publishes no price for the dashboard itself.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard page does not specify how many users must hold an Agent 365 licence for the toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: Agent 365 Dashboard licensing number licenses price meter dashboard. Read Agent Dashboard licensing requirements in full: 'plus Agent 365 licensing' has no quantity. Agent 365 overview gives a product enablement prerequisite, not a dashboard-specific quantity.

claims.quote: It includes two different reporting experiences or views: ... Agent 365 Dashboard ... If you have access to the Agent Dashboard, you can find it in the Viva Insights web app.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The Agent 365 view lists agents by name.
claims.quote: You can view and search the list of the top agents used in your organization, and use the headers to sort based on the agent name, or the corresponding metrics for each agent.

claims.claim: Listed agents have session metrics in the Agent 365 view.
claims.quote: Agent 365 Dashboard metrics include sessions, the number of active users, and the change in active users.

claims.claim: Listed agents have active-user metrics in the Agent 365 view.
claims.quote: Agent 365 Dashboard metrics include sessions, the number of active users, and the change in active users.

claims.claim: Activity reporting can be broken down by group.
claims.quote: View by groups, organization, job function, or license: Select View by to drill down into different groups.

claims.claim: Activity reporting can be broken down by organisation.
claims.quote: Users can change this to view the data by other organizational attributes like Organization and Job function.

claims.claim: Activity reporting can be broken down by job function when that data is uploaded.
claims.quote: Users can change this to view the data by other organizational attributes like Organization and Job function.

claims.claim: Job-function reporting requires uploaded organisational job-function attributes.
claims.quote: The Job function filter only appears if your Insights admin uploads a .csv file with the organizational data attribute of FunctionType or your Global admin uploads a .csv file with the organizational data attribute of JobDiscipline.

claims.claim: The analysed population includes all employees who have had agent activity.
claims.quote: The analyzed population in the Agent Dashboard includes all employees who have had agent activity.

claims.claim: The minimum group size suppresses agent names and group metrics for smaller groups.
claims.quote: To protect individual privacy, agent names and group metrics aren't shown for groups that are smaller than the minimum group size.

claims.claim: The minimum group size defaults to 10 employees.
claims.quote: The dashboards' adoption and impact pages provide group-level metrics for groups that meet or exceed the minimum group size you set, which by default is 10 employees.

claims.claim: The minimum group size cannot be set below five.
claims.quote: Enter your preferred minimum group size, which must be at least five, then select Save.

claims.claim: Non-public agents have creator type Your org or user.
claims.quote: Non-public agents include agents with a creator type of Your org or user, and might not be available to all users in your organization.

claims.claim: Public agents include those created by Microsoft and third parties.
claims.quote: Public agents include those created by Microsoft and third parties.

claims.claim: The non-public agent reporting policy can be changed at tenant, group or user level.
claims.quote: Similar to the Agent Dashboard on/off control, the AI admin can change this control at the tenant, group, or user level.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Qualifying senior leaders gain dashboard access automatically.
claims.quote: Users who are senior leaders within large teams as determined by their Entra ID data manager attribute can automatically view the report.

claims.claim: Automatic senior-leader access requires a tenant with a single main reporting line.
claims.quote: The majority of users in the tenant are part of a single reporting line; for example, they report to the same CEO

claims.claim: Automatic senior-leader access requires at least 2,500 users with an Entra ID.
claims.quote: The tenant has at least 2,500 users with an Entra ID

claims.claim: Global Administrators have dashboard access, subject to the stated PIM exception.
claims.quote: Users who are assigned the Global administrator role also have access to the Agent Dashboard. ... If you're a Privileged Identity Management (PIM) enabled tenant, global admins might not have access to the Agent Dashboard.

claims.claim: Enabled managers already holding team-level Copilot Analytics access can access the dashboard.
claims.quote: Enabled managers who already have team-level access to Copilot Analytics in Viva Insights can also access the dashboard.

claims.claim: Viva Insights analysts with global partition access have automatic access.
claims.quote: The following types of users also have automatic access to the Agent Dashboard: Viva Insights Analysts with global partition access

claims.claim: Users with delegate access have dashboard access.
claims.quote: The following types of users also have automatic access to the Agent Dashboard: ... Users with delegate access

claims.claim: Learn directs PIM-enabled tenants to explicitly add Global Administrators through the web-app access settings when access is needed.
claims.quote: If you want to give global admins access to the Agent Dashboard, add them explicitly using these steps

claims.claim: Users with dashboard access can delegate access to other people in their company.
claims.quote: If you have access to the Agent Dashboard, you can also delegate access to the dashboard to other people in your company.

claims.claim: Both the web-app and Agent Dashboard controls must be enabled to reach the dashboard.
claims.quote: To access the Agent Dashboard, both the Viva Insights web app control and this control must be enabled.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard Learn page describes reporting tools, not actions taken on agents from the dashboard.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Agent 365 Dashboard actions on agents metrics filters deep dive. Read the complete Agent Dashboard page, including Key actions and deep dives; it describes viewing, filtering and reporting, not agent-management actions.

claims.claim: The All agents toggle does not appear when the Agent 365 view's licensing requirement is unmet.
claims.quote: If your organization doesn't meet this requirement, the All agents toggle won't appear in the dashboard.

claims.claim: The dashboard is currently unavailable in national or regional clouds, including U.S. Government clouds and Office 365 operated by 21Vianet.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard isn't currently available for national/regional cloud deployments including but not limited to Microsoft's U.S. Government clouds and Office 365 operated by 21Vianet.

claims.claim: The settings page assigns management of the Agent Dashboard and web-app settings to the AI Administrator.
claims.quote: Enable or disable the Viva Insights web app ... Applies to: AI Administrator ... Enable or disable the Agent Dashboard ... Applies to: AI Administrator

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators can manage all settings on the settings page.
claims.quote: In addition to the roles described below, all settings can also be managed by Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.

claims.claim: The feature-access-management overview instead lists Global admin for the web-app control.
claims.quote: | Viva Insights web app | No | Global admin | Viva Insights |

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard obtains organisational data from Microsoft Entra ID by default.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard can get organizational data in one of three ways: Through Microsoft Entra ID, which is the default setting

claims.claim: Uploading an organisational data file permanently changes the Agent Dashboard data source from Entra ID to that file.
claims.quote: If you upload an organizational data file, this permanently changes the source of the Agent Dashboard data from Microsoft Entra ID to the data file, including data for the Scope and Organization filters.

claims.claim: The automatic access criteria are analysed weekly to capture organisational changes.
claims.quote: The criteria above are analyzed on a weekly basis to capture any major organization changes.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard policy route is Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Access Management > Turn Advanced Insights on or off > Feature access management > Agent Dashboard > Add policy.
claims.quote: Go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights. ... Set up and management ... Under Access Management, select Turn Advanced Insights on or off. ... Feature access management ... select Agent Dashboard and Add policy.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId AgentDashboard -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide policy disabling the Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Agent Dashboard for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights ... FeatureId : AgentDashboard ... Name : DisableFeatureForAll ... IsFeatureEnabled : false ... Everyone

claims.claim: The individual-user web-app access route is Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users > Add.
claims.quote: Settings ... Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights ... Set up and management ... Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... At the top, select Users. ... At the bottom, select Add.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide policy disabling the web app.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights ... FeatureId : Viva Insights web app ... Name : DisableFeatureForAll ... IsFeatureEnabled : false ... Everyone

claims.claim: Automation for setting the Agent Dashboard minimum group size is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Agent Dashboard minimum group size PowerShell Microsoft Graph API privacy settings; Viva Insights minimum group size Set-VivaInsightsSettings API PowerShell. Read settings, privacy settings and Set-VivaInsightsSettings excerpts; no threshold-setting call found.

claims.claim: With a Viva Insights licence, a Viva Insights Administrator uses the privacy settings page to change minimum group size instead.
claims.quote: Or, if your tenant has a Viva Insights license and you're a Viva Insights Administrator, use these steps to change the minimum group size

claims.claim: Turning off the web-app control disables the entire app, including the Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports and advanced analysis tools.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: VFAM access-policy changes take effect within 24 hours unless a feature states otherwise.
claims.quote: Changes to access policies take effect for the user within 24 hours, unless noted for a specific feature.

claims.claim: User or group policies take precedence over tenant policies.
claims.quote: Policy Scope Levels (Most to Least Restrictive): User or Group Policies; Tenant Policy; Defaults

claims.claim: Within the same policy scope level, the most restrictive enablement policy applies.
claims.quote: The most restrictive Policy Scope Level takes precedence first. Then within a single Policy Scope Level, the most restrictive Enablement Policy takes precedence.

claims.claim: The unified exclusion list hides selected employees' data from dashboard aggregates and is not specific to the Agent 365 view.
claims.quote: Create a unified exclusion list for the Copilot Dashboard, Agent Dashboard, Consumption Dashboard, and Viva Insights (hide users from aggregates) ... The user exclusion list allows admins to specify which employees' data should not be shown in the dashboard or other Viva Insights reports.

claims.claim: The settings page links to Viva Feature Access Management guidance for the exclusion list.
claims.quote: You can manage the exclusion list with Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) using PowerShell or VFAM. Learn more

claims.claim: The Users route adds individuals; selecting Groups instead permits adding groups.
claims.quote: To enable access for new individual users: At the top, select Users. ... To enable access for new groups: At the top, select Groups. ... At the bottom, select Add.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard control can disable access at tenant, group or user level, including access to the Agent 365 view.
claims.quote: The AI admin can enable or disable the Agent Dashboard at the tenant, group, or user level using the Agent Dashboard VFAM control in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Turning this control off disables the Agent Dashboard.
